pictures.viewed: Existing 1440x1385 aerial actually inspected at natural size: southern detached polygon east of the southern apartments has a dark open center and low pale perimeter inside the path. Northern/east latrine is a separate partly obscured structure. Roofless visible center is supported; no qualified heights or detailed archaeological inventory inferred.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Detached southern polygonal latrine remains, on its own exact eight-sided mapped footprint east of the southern apartments. Low broad rubble walls, irregular broken caps, a reconstructed west-facing entrance gap toward the main villa and a genuinely open center retain original ground. No speculative intact ancient roof, invented conservation canopy, mosaic copy, furnishings, benches or underground plumbing. Main villa, Triclinium, Xystus, entrance and the northern east-latrine draft remain independent.
